description: Pre-configured flux topologies and uplift parameters for volume modulus stability testing.

configurations.name: Stable de Sitter Vacuum (Metastable Dark Energy)
configurations.description: Balanced flux and anti-D3 brane uplift producing a local minimum with small positive cosmological constant.

configurations.name: Un-uplifted Anti-de Sitter Well
configurations.description: Pure F-term potential without anti-D3 brane uplift (C_uplift = 0). Yields a stable SUSY AdS minimum.

configurations.name: Overlifted Runaway Decompactification
configurations.description: High anti-D3 brane tension that destroys the potential barrier, causing the extra dimensions to expand infinitely.
